correctness.rationale: Exact type-word state graph: every 3^n word and every unordered occupied seat pair on C_n for n=3,4,5,6 is considered under u_i=[next type on either side]. Separate exhaustive Python implementation verified edge totals 0,24,180,882 and SCC size multisets empty,empty,empty,{6:6}; six SCCs each have exactly six internal edges, and source supplies explicit six-step gain-positive cycle. Exhaustion is a genuine finite proof of the restricted n<=6 statement, not extrapolation to larger n; stable optimal seating coexists with the cycles.

Their nonconvergence example on a path uses different preferences; Ceylan–Chen–Roy (IJCAI 2023) treats optimization/decision complexity.

value.rationale: A first obstruction to convergence of strictly mutually beneficial exchanges is meaningful in cyclic seating games: stable states exist but improving trajectories can loop. The sharp six-seat cutoff, exact 36-word orbit, and six directed components are naturally defined finite classifications, not an arbitrary parameter sample.
